rows.en: Huh? So this is some other world?
...That's quite likely. Anyway, let's try walking around a bit.
You're right... It's like a whole other world.
...Tch, what the hell is going on!?
I think we were probably transported here in an instant.
Let's explore a little! We might find out something!
You're right... It's like a whole other world.
...Tch, what the hell is going on!?
Most likely, we were transported here instantaneously.
Let's explore a little. We might learn something.
Different? Nah, it's more than that. It's like a whole other world.
...Tch, what the hell is going on!?
No idea. But we ended up here all of a sudden.
That much is certain.
Hmph... Well, I guess nothing that happens should surprise me anymore.
Let's explore a little. We might figure something out.
No, it's more than that. It's like a different world entirely.
...Tch, what the hell is going on!?
All I can think is that we were transported in an instant...
Anyway, let's explore a little. We might learn something.
Hey! Why the hell did we suddenly end up in a place like this?
How should I know?
Geez, what a useless hand you are!
Fine, guess we'll wander around a bit.
A rumble like bombing echoed from somewhere far off...
...Bombing?
Is there a war goin' on?
...That's bombing.
There's fighting going on somewhere.
...Bombing?
It's like a battlefield...
...That's bombing.
Is there fighting going on somewhere?
...That's bombing.
So this place is a battlefield, huh!!
...That's bombing.
Is there fighting going on somewhere?
...Hm? What's that?
Is that bombing?
Suddenly, a violent explosion rocked the area!!
Tch! That one was pretty close...
Yeah. That was some awful shaking.
What on earth is going on?
Yeah. That was some awful shaking.
What on earth is going on?
Yeah. Just feel how hard it's shaking.
Still, what on earth is going on?
Yeah, it shook pretty hard.
But a little shaking like that is nothing to me.
More importantly, what on earth is going on?
That was one hell of a shake!
What the heck is going on?
Yes. That was terrible shaking.
What could possibly be happening!?
Yeah. It shook pretty hard.
Ugh...
Are you all right!?
Are you okay!?
Are you okay!?
Hey, you okay!?
You okay!?
You okay!?
Are you all right!?
...A... A Gundam got us... A type I've never seen before...
A Gundam!?
A Gundam!?
A Gundam!?
A Gundam!?
A Gundam!?
A Gundam!?
A Gundam!?
Yeah... Gundams... Three of them showed up...
Urgh...
Hey! Hang in there!!
Hey! Hang in there!!
Hey! Hang in there!!
Hey! Hang in there!!
Hey! Pull yourself together!!
Hey! Hang in there!!

notes.note: Answers W (Shotaro)'s 'These ruins... this isn't Fuuto' (0201 #0.8, story_019). 0201 is a scene with one variant per party partner of Ankh (OOO, W, Mebius, Nu Gundam, Zero, Zeta Gundam, Den-O), so near-identical lines repeat.
'You're right' agrees with Ankh's opening 'the atmosphere's different' (0201 #0.1); the line before this variant (#0.11) is not in the slice.

Source opens 'No, rather than that...': Zero topping Ankh's 'the atmosphere's different'. Added 'Different?' to make the referent clear in English. Same structure at #0.29 (Zeta Gundam), kept plainer.
Deliberately trails off in the source; kept unfinished.
Momotaros insulting Ankh, who is a disembodied arm/hand ('useless hand'). Insult kept.

0202 #0.6-0.22 have no recovered speaker. They are per-partner variants (pairs) of the Den-O rows #0.3-0.4; order of partners not recoverable, so lines kept speaker-neutral. #0.16 reads like Zero, #0.21-0.22 casual (possibly OOO), but unconfirmed.

0203 #0.7-0.8 and #0.11-0.18 have no recovered speaker; per-partner variants answering Ankh's 'That one was pretty close'. #0.16-0.17 are polite (likely Mebius), #0.12 boastful (likely Zero), #0.14-0.15 rough (likely Den-O). Kept speaker-neutral.
Source is just 'Yeah, this shaking': Shotaro confirming Ankh's 'that was close' by pointing at the tremor. Rendered as 'Just feel how hard it's shaking.'
Maganac pilot, dying. 'got us' chosen for the passive 'was done in by a Gundam'; Maganac Corps are a group, so 'us' fits. 'Gundam' kept singular here; #0.17 clarifies there were three.

report: 80/80 rows examined. Speakers missing for 0202 #0.6-0.22 and 0203 #0.7-0.8, #0.11-0.18 (party-partner variants); kept speaker-neutral. No new names or terms outside the glossary.
